notes: Note: min = minimum, max = maximum, nc = national currency, fc = foreign currency,WAIR = Weighted Average Interest Rate.
1/ Open Market Operations(7 days ) was introduced on 27 August 2009.
2/ Open Market Operations(14 days ) was introduced on 14 February 2011.
3/ MMA repurchase facility rate was introduced on 23 Nov 2006 replacing the Lombard facility which was introduced in August 2001.
4/ MMA introduced overnight deposit facility for commercial banks effective from 23 March 2010.
5/ Effective from 9th May 2010 MMA introduced Overnight Lombard facility replacing repurchase facility rate.
6/ Loans and advances min and max rates include the penal rates charged on unplanned advances or overdrafts and overdue installments.

7/ The Government of Maldives introduced Treasury bills on 11 Sep, 2006. With effective from 27 December 2009 the T-bill rates represents the current weighted average interest rate offered by the government.
8/ MAISX is calculated since the inception of Securites Trading Floor (Maldives Stock Exchange) on 5 May 2002.
